subject: Expansion: additional squads for WalletSuite — contract & keys
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@walletsuite.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — adding 10 squads / new apps

Hi Priya,

We had a planning sync this morning and WalletSuite is ready to expand the Redwood deployment to cover a second wave of internal teams. Rough summary: we want to onboard 10 additional squads across three new projects (User Wallets, Merchant Settlements, Fraud Insights). Estimated steady-state traffic: 1.2M tokens/day across all apps, with peak bursts up to ~12 reqs/s/region.

Primary asks from our side:
- New sets of API credentials (separate key per project + per environment: dev/stage/prod)
- Updated pricing for the additional usage and any multi-project discounts
- Proposed timeline for staged provisioning (we'd like dev access within 2 weeks)
- An amendment or PO-ready quote showing term changes and committed units for procurement
- SOC2 artifacts and a short IP/egress allowlist for our network team

I attached our RFP summary and a short product brief. Procurement will likely request an amendment rather than a new contract; I'm copying them on follow-ups.

Can you confirm feasibility and next steps? We aim to have procurement sign-off by end of month.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product, WalletSuite
engineering@walletsuite.com
Attachment: WalletSuite_RFP_Q1_2028.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Expansion request — adding 10 squads / new apps

Folks — forwarding WalletSuite's request. High-level asks: new per-project keys, staged provisioning (dev in 2w), updated pricing + amendment for procurement. Deal id WS-2028-0423. Region: US.

Ben: can you validate capacity and a recommended staging plan (dev -> stage -> prod) we can commit to? Also call out any rate-limit changes we should propose.

Marissa: can you draft a one-page amendment/price summary we can send to Procurement (they want PO-ready language)? If we can give a 10% MSR discount at commit X it might help close faster — please advise.

I'll coordinate SOC2 artifacts and get the IP allowlist. Aim to respond to WalletSuite within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Expansion request — adding 10 squads / new apps

Priya / Marissa,

Summary after quick capacity check: this is doable with our Dedicated pool sizing and staged rollout. Recommended plan:

Stage 0 (prep, 3 days): offboard testing tokens, schema & prompt set verification, enable prefix caching for WalletSuite models.
Stage 1 (dev): issue 3 project-specific dev keys (dev environment only) — ~3k qps quota per tenant, ready in 5 business days.
Stage 2 (staging): add 3 staging keys with controlled burst limits (10 reqs/s each).
Stage 3 (prod): enable full quotas and autoscaling; for 1.2M tokens/day and peak 12 reqs/s/region we suggest committing to a reserved baseline of 2 x A40-equivalent slots with burst capacity.

Cost note: rough delta vs current usage is $18k/month at standard rates. For a committed 12-month addendum we can offer a 10% discount at $16.2k/month. If they want a shorter 6-month commitment, discount falls to 5%.

Items I need from the customer to proceed:
- Confirm number of distinct API keys required (per-project + per-env)
- Procurement PO or expected billing entity and billing email
- SOC2 contact (we can send our SOC2 report and a security questionnaire)

I've attached the capacity runbook and a short checklist for staged issuance. Also: we'll need to update quota limits in the console (I can do that once Marissa confirms pricing).

—Ben
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity_runbook_v2.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@walletsuite.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — adding 10 squads / new apps

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear scope. We're aligned on feasibility. Proposed next steps and commercial summary below so Procurement has everything in one place.

Commercial & timeline (proposal):
- Staged provisioning: dev keys in 5 business days, staging in 2 weeks, prod activation on receipt of PO — aim for full prod in 4 weeks from PO.
- Pricing: incremental usage estimate ~$18,000/month; 12-month committed addendum = $16,200/month (10% discount). 6-month term = $17,100/month (5% discount).
- Amendment: we will issue an addendum that updates committed units and adds the three new project line-items. Draft attached (DocuSign link below).

Security & procurement:
- SOC2: we'll send the report and completed security questionnaire to your SOC contact.
- IP allowlist: the prod egress IPs are: 34.82.113.6, 35.202.77.12 (we'll provide a signed allowlist).

Required from WalletSuite:
1) Confirmation of number of keys (per-project x per-environment) — if you want separate keys for dev/stage/prod across 3 projects, that'll be 9 keys total; if you prefer a single project key per project for staging/dev we can adapt.
2) Procurement contact & billing entity (we need PO flow or card on file) — please introduce your procurement lead so we can send PO-ready docs.
3) Expected start date for dev access (proposed: March 29th).

Links & attachments:
- Draft amendment (attached) and DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcd-1234-amendment
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
- Attachment: redwood-amendment-draft.pdf

If that looks good I'll send the amendment to procurement and Ben will queue the dev keys and configure quotas.

Best,
Priya
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
From: Marcus Hale <procurement@walletsuite.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@walletsuite.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — adding 10 squads / new apps

Thanks Priya — procurement here. We can move on the 12-month addendum. A couple quick asks before PO:
1) Please send the most recent SOC2 report and a completed security questionnaire.
2) We need the finalized list of prod egress IPs for our network team to whitelist (the two you listed are fine but we'll need a formal allowlist).
3) Can you clarify billing entity and invoice cadence (monthly in advance or net-30)? We prefer monthly in arrears but can accept net-30 on a purchase order.

Once we have the SOC2 + allowlist we can issue the PO this week. Marcus Hale
Procurement Manager, WalletSuite
procurement@walletsuite.com
